info.title: Daddy Jokes API
info.description: One dad joke a day. Errors use RFC 9457 problem details with a stable `code`. Send the access token as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`; refresh it with POST /v1/auth/refresh.

delivered.description: Jokes delivered in the last 24 hours.

openRate7d.description: Share of delivered jokes opened, last 7 days (0-1).

clearingKes.description: Net money through M-Pesa: tips in minus payouts out, all time.

actor.description: Null when the system did it.

sample.description: A recent favourite to show on the landing page.

value.description: A literal (number, text, true/false, a list), or { ref } to another fact.

expect.description: Outputs that must come out, e.g. { hide: true }.

system.description: Used by the app itself; can be edited but not archived.

updatedBy.description: Handle of whoever saved it last.

system.description: Used by the app itself; can be edited but not archived.

revision.description: Send it back when saving, so two people can't overwrite each other.

version.description: The version evaluated; null for the draft.

published.description: False when a test failed; nothing changed then.

stopUnlessMatched.description: Stop the run when no rule matched (only the default applied).

workflowVersion.description: 0 for test runs of the draft.
0 for test runs of the draft.

userId.description: Who to run it for. Defaults to you.

mode.description: test runs the draft and skips waits; live runs the published version.

region.description: Country whose readers need local knowledge to get it. Null: works everywhere.

imageKey.description: The key from POST /v1/me/uploads, after the file is uploaded.

region.description: Country whose readers need local knowledge to get it. Null: works everywhere.

removed.description: Taken down by curators after it went out.

jokeId.description: Only once opened: the joke stays sealed until then.

current.description: Today's joke, or yesterday's if it can still be opened.

streak.description: Days in a row with the joke opened.

reached.description: Readers your jokes were delivered to.

tipsKes.description: Tips paid for your jokes, before the platform fee.

canDelete.description: Authors can delete their own comments; admins any.

canHide.description: Curators and admins can hide a comment from readers.

hidden.description: Hidden from readers (only staff and the author see it).

at.description: When it happened. Defaults to now; clamped to the last day.

hidden.description: Hidden from readers automatically, waiting for a decision.

resolvedBy.description: Handle of the curator who decided.

hidden.description: It's now hidden from readers while curators review it.

removed.description: Taken down by curators after it went out.

url.description: Where tapping it should go in the app.

phone.description: The M-Pesa number to charge. It gets a prompt to enter the PIN.

note.description: Shown with the tip under the joke and in the writer's notification.

anonymous.description: Hide my name on the joke and from the writer.

message.description: What to tell the tipper about the current status.

simulated.description: Test mode: no real money moves. Answer the prompt with simulateTipPrompt.

pendingKes.description: Earned but still on hold; becomes available after the hold.

nextReleaseAt.description: When the next pending earnings become available.

lifetimeTipsKes.description: Everything tipped to you, after the platform fee.

creatorFundKes.description: Everything paid to you from the creator fund.

noteHidden.description: The writer or a curator hid the message.

from.description: Null when the tipper chose to stay anonymous.

canModerate.description: The viewer can hide messages (the writer, or a curator).

tips.description: Paid tips charged at this rate.

creatorHandle.description: Leave out for the default rate; set for one writer's own rate.

effectiveFrom.description: Defaults to now. Can't be in the past.

triggeredBy.description: Handle of the admin who ran it; null for the daily run.
